# Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Codegen

## Purpose

This project compiles the GTFS-Realtime `.proto` schema into C# classes using `Grpc.Tools`. It is the sole source of the generated `TransitRealtime.*` types used throughout the solution.

## Important: no hand-written C# source files

**Do not add `.cs` files to this project.** The entire C# output is generated by `protoc` at build time from `gtfsrt.proto`. Adding hand-written source here would create a maintenance burden and risks conflicts with regenerated code.

## Generated types

All generated classes live in the `TransitRealtime` namespace. Key types:

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| `FeedMessage` | Root message — contains a `FeedHeader` and a list of `FeedEntity` items |
| `FeedHeader` | Metadata: `GtfsRealtimeVersion`, `Incrementality`, `Timestamp` |
| `FeedEntity` | Wrapper with an `Id` and one of: `TripUpdate`, `VehiclePosition`, or `Alert` |
| `Alert` | Service alert with `Cause`, `Effect`, `HeaderText`, `DescriptionText`, `Url`, `InformedEntity`, `ActivePeriod` |
| `TripUpdate` | Real-time trip update |
| `VehiclePosition` | Real-time vehicle location |

## How generation works

The `.csproj` contains a single `<Protobuf>` item:

```xml
<Protobuf
    Include="..\Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Protos\Protos\gtfsrt.proto"
    GrpcServices="None"
    ProtoRoot="..\Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Protos\Protos"
    AdditionalImportDirs="$(PkgGoogle_Api_CommonProtos)\content\protos" />
```

- `GrpcServices="None"` — generates message classes only; no gRPC client/server stubs.
- `protoc` (from `Grpc.Tools`) runs automatically during `dotnet build`.
- Generated `.cs` files are placed in `obj/` and never committed to source control.

## How to trigger regeneration

Just build the project:

```bash
dotnet build Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Codegen
```

Or build the full solution — dependent projects will trigger the codegen transitively.

## Why this is a separate project

C# `partial class` only works within a single compilation unit (assembly). Because the generated `FeedMessage` class is compiled into `Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Codegen.dll`, it is **impossible** to extend it with a `partial class` from `Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Proto.Helpers` (a different assembly). Keeping codegen isolated makes this boundary explicit and prevents accidental cross-assembly partial class attempts.

If you need to add methods or interface implementations to a generated type, add a `.cs` file **inside this project** (not in Proto.Helpers). Be aware that those additions will not be regenerated — they are hand-written and must be maintained manually alongside any proto schema changes.

## Dependency chain

```
Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Protos   (proto source files)
        ↓
Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Codegen  (generates TransitRealtime.* types)
        ↓
Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Proto.Helpers  (uses TransitRealtime.* + Stopwatch domain types)
        ↓
Mtd.GtfsRealTime.Api      (uses Proto.Helpers + Codegen directly)
```
